desc:
🥚 Why is there a GIANT EGG in this lab?!

Your job is simple: CRACK IT OPEN. ⛏️
Don't ask questions. Just keep cracking.

💥 Break through the egg
⛏️ Upgrade your tools
💰 Get stronger & progress
👥 Play solo or with up to 4 players
🥚 Discover what's hiding inside...

CRACK is a 1–4 player co-op incremental adventure all about breaking through a mysterious giant egg.

What's inside? There's only one way to find out. 👀
